description: This file is a shell script for testing SVN branch movements, cloning with git svn, and verifying the existence of directory b1.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, used to run SVN dump load, clone, and directory check operations.

methods.name: svnadmin load
methods.description: Loads SVN dumpfile into the repository.

methods.name: git svn clone
methods.description: Clones an SVN repository using git with subdirectory mode.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a specified directory (b1) is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of testing in the script.
